title: Kusanagi Nene — I Can't Rest〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa!
What if we jumped really high into the air at the end of that action scene we just did?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you mind if we went over a few things regarding the next scene, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everybody looks like they're having a lot of fun... To be fair, it is the first show we're putting together from scratch in a while.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The plushies surprised us when they requested that we put on a show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I really do enjoy this process.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The show we're working on now is a comedic musical that takes place in a city.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm playing the gossipy owner of a flower shop... I'm also a bit of a troublemaker since I like to spread unfounded rumors.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's a bit of a nuisance, but endearing at the same time. I hope I can properly capture her charm.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, let's take a break here!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Nice work, Nene!
I brought some snacks, so let's go have them over there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I want to keep practicing for a bit longer. Mind starting your break without me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, you're not gonna take your break?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm having a little trouble with my character, and I wanna get it right before we start rehearsing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay...
But I thought the way you played that flower shop lady was really good...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's bothering you exactly?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Umm... So, you know how she's a bit of a troublemaker? I feel like I'm currently making her look like a gigantic nuisance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm trying to go more for the angle that she isn't there to cause trouble, and things usually just end up going wrong all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right. That lady isn't trying to hurt anyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She just feels the need to let everyone know about the rumors she's heard.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That might be it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The way I'm acting now is making it hard for me to show how she wants everybody to know what she's heard.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's been like she thinks spreading rumors is fun... I think I got hung up on the comedy aspect and went too over-the-top.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I should be trying to present her more as someone who's just trying to help others.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that'd make her such a fun and nice person!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that is a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I agree! Not only does it give her more depth, it should make her a much more charming character!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wanna ask how long you guys have been listening... But it works out since I was also hoping to hear your opinions.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm thinking about playing her like that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My character is going to feel a little milder as a result, so I'll need to strike a balance somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't you do that by changing the way she speaks? She could talk quickly or have a funny speech pattern. That should give her quite a bit of presence.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I like that.
Why don't we try coming up with some patterns now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you're going to change the way she speaks, then you'll also need to adjust her lines a little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you guys too, MEIKO, KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what are you guys all talking about?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think it's a meeting on how to give Nene's character a big power boost☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? You're all here now?! When did that happen?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I feel kinda bad roping all of you in like this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I would really appreciate your guys' help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, let's get back to practice, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Miku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so glad we figured out a good plan for your flower shop lady, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too. Thanks for coming up with all those great ideas, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I doubt things would've come together so nicely if I'd kept thinking on my own...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And I feel a lot more relaxed after talking to them.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I feel like I can really do her justice now.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, you guys...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks for helping me with this.
Again, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I'm very much looking forward to seeing how you play her now, Nene.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best to turn this into a great show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...!
